display_title: FuseNet Call for the Organisation of Mini-Workshops in Fusion – EUROfusion
call_title: FuseNet Call for the Organisation of Mini-Workshops in Fusion
executive_summary: Cascade call issued within EUROfusion, the consortium implementing the European fusion research roadmap (grant agreement 101052200, funded by the Euratom Research and Training Programme), and run by FuseNet, the European Fusion Education Network. It reimburses the actual costs, up to EUR 10,000 per event, of 2 to 5 day mini-workshops (masterclasses) on a specialised fusion topic for at least 10 MSc or PhD students, covering accommodation and meals so that participation is free; travel of external lecturers is not covered. Only FuseNet member institutions may apply. Total funding EUR 10,000; applications are reviewed periodically until the budget is used, with a deadline of 31 December 2026 for workshops held before the end of 2026; payment follows after the workshop and its deliverables (report, participant list, survey, lecture recordings).
status_rationale: The FuseNet mini-workshops Terms and Conditions 2026 (sections 2 Eligibility and 3 Type of support) and the FuseNet call page fund short masterclasses in fusion science for MSc and PhD students, organised by FuseNet member institutions. It does not touch TenneT's field: no project file is close, and fusion research education does not build the transmission, grid-operation or offshore workforce or knowledge TenneT relies on. The project end date is the end of 2026, the year by which the call page says workshops must be held; no start date or duration is stated.
